summary: That Dam is a large stupa in Vientiane, Laos, whose Lao name ທາດດຳ means Black Stupa. According to the note, many Laotians believe a seven-headed nāga inhabits it and once tried to protect them from a Siamese army invasion in 1827.
one_line: That Dam, the large Black Stupa in Vientiane, Laos, is associated with a local belief in a seven-headed nāga guardian.
key_facts: That Dam is a large stupa located in Vientiane, Laos.
The Lao name of That Dam is ທາດດຳ, meaning Black Stupa.
Many Laotians believe That Dam is inhabited by a seven-headed nāga.
The seven-headed nāga is believed to have tried to protect Laotians from an invasion by the Siamese army in 1827.
